identifiers.name: NIS code
identifiers.description: The 5-digit code of a Belgian municipality given by Statbel (also called INS or REFNIS code): the level at which a distribution operator, local planning rules and most datasets are decided. The first digit names the province, or 2 for Brussels. It is not the postal code.

identifiers.name: Basisregisters address
identifiers.description: The persistent identifier of an address in the Flemish address register (Adressenregister). Flanders only.

identifiers.name: Basisregisters building (gebouwID)
identifiers.description: The persistent identifier of a building in the Flemish building register (Gebouwenregister). Flanders only.

identifiers.name: UrbIS building
identifiers.description: The identifier of a building in UrbIS-Adm, the Brussels reference map. Brussels only.

identifiers.name: ICAR address
identifiers.description: The identifier of a house number in ICAR, the Walloon address register. Wallonia keeps no building register: an ICAR address is the most precise identifier of a place there.

identifiers.name: Enterprise number
identifiers.description: The 10-digit number of an enterprise in the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO / BCE), starting with 0 or 1, written here without dots.
